entity.agency: Alabama Secretary of State, Business Entity Division
entity.summary: Form your LLC, corporation or partnership by filing with the Alabama Secretary of State. Out-of-state companies must qualify to do business in Alabama there too.
entity.quote: The types of entities we serve include For-Profit Corporations, Non-Profit Corporations, Limited Liability Companies, Limited Partnerships, Registered Limited Liability Partnerships, and Limited Liability Limited Partnerships.

state_tax.summary: Register for your state tax accounts (such as sales/use tax and payroll withholding) online through My Alabama Taxes. If you have employees working in Alabama you need a withholding tax account number.
state_tax.quote: If you are an employer with employees working in the state of Alabama, you will need to register with the Department of Revenue for a withholding tax account number.

unemployment.agency: Alabama Department of Workforce (formerly Department of Labor)
unemployment.summary: Once you pay wages for work in Alabama, register for an unemployment compensation account number online through the department's eGov system.
unemployment.quote: Once wages have been paid for work performed in Alabama, you may apply for a new number with eGov

workers_comp.agency: Alabama Department of Workforce, Workers' Compensation Division
workers_comp.summary: Businesses with five or more employees (counting part-time workers, corporate officers and LLC members) must carry workers' compensation. Smaller employers are generally exempt, except companies building or helping build new single-family detached homes, which must carry it regardless of size.
workers_comp.quote: If you regularly employ fewer than five employees—full-time or part-time, including corporate officers—you are generally not required to carry workers’ compensation insurance under Alabama law. The exception is businesses involved in constructing or assisting on-site with new single-family, detached residential homes, which are required to maintain coverage.

local.summary: Cities and counties in Alabama issue their own business or occupational licenses to contractors; check with the city and county where you work.
local.quote: business or occupational license as a contractor issued by a municipality, township, or county in the state

residential_building.name: Home Builder License (Unlimited or Limited)
residential_building.covers: Anyone who builds, remodels, repairs or improves residences when the cost of the job exceeds $10,000.
residential_building.threshold: Residential jobs costing more than $10,000 (more than $2,500 for residential roofing).
prerequisites: Unlimited license: pass the Alabama Home Builders Business & Law exam and Skills exam
Limited license: a current (or held within the past year) city or county contractor business license
A credit report sent to the Board to show financial responsibility
Corporations/LLCs: a Certificate of Compliance from the Alabama Department of Revenue
Proof of U.S. citizenship or lawful presence
residential_building.summary: Alabama requires a Home Builders license for residential construction and remodeling jobs over $10,000. For an Unlimited license you must pass the state exams; a Limited license is based on an existing local contractor license. You also need to send the Board a credit report.
residential_building.quote: cost of the undertaking exceeds ten thousand dollars ($10,000). Notwithstanding the foregoing, the term includes a residential roofer when the cost of the undertaking exceeds two thousand five hundred dollars ($2,500)

evidence.quote: To receive an Unlimited License, take and pass the Alabama Home Builders Exams.

To receive a Limited or Roofers L icense, applicant must provide a copy of a currently held, or held on or before one (1) year prior to the date of the application, business or occupational license as a contractor issued by a municipality, township, or county in the state.
To receive an Unlimited or Limited License, request that a current credit report on the individual or business who is making application be sent to the Board directly from a credit-reporting agency.
Provide a Certificate of Compliance from the Alabama Department of Revenue .
All applicants must provide proof of citizenship with a copy of a driver license, birth certificate, or passport, or provide proof that they are lawfully present in this state.

commercial_building.name: General Contractor License (prime or subcontractor)
commercial_building.agency: Alabama Licensing Board for General Contractors
commercial_building.covers: Contractors who build, alter, repair or demolish buildings, sites and other projects where the job costs $100,000 or more (swimming pools $5,000 or more). Subcontractors at that size must be licensed too.
commercial_building.threshold: Projects of $100,000 or more including labor and materials ($5,000 or more for swimming pools).
prerequisites: Prime contractors must pass a Business and Law exam administered by PSI
Three references from general contractors, architects, engineers or awarding authorities you have worked for
Application on file before a quarterly Board meeting
commercial_building.summary: A state General Contractor license is required for projects of $100,000 or more (swimming pools $5,000 or more). Prime contractors must pass a Business and Law exam, and all applicants submit three references. Subcontractors may bid without a license but must be licensed before starting work.
commercial_building.quote: where the cost of the undertaking including labor and materials is $100,000 or more. Swimming Pool construction of $5,000 or more.

evidence.quote: The application has to be on file 30 days prior to a Board meeting which are held quarterly. All primes must take a Business and Law Exam administered by PSI.

Three references from General Contractors, Architects, Engineers, or awarding authorities that you have completed work for must be submitted with your application. A subcontractor is allowed to bid to a General Contractor but cannot start the job until licensed.
Subcontractors performing minimum contracts including labor and materials of $100,000 ($5,000 swimming pools) under contract to a licensed prime contractor must be licensed by the board.

commercial_building.note: Act 2026-396 added exemptions (residential swimming pools, certain routine maintenance and repair) effective October 1, 2026; ask the Board about specific projects.

electrical.name: Electrical Contractor License (Master Electrician) and Journeyman Electrician License
electrical.covers: Any person or business that solicits or installs, maintains, alters or repairs electrical power or control systems. Journeymen must work under a master or state-certified electrical contractor.
prerequisites: Pass the Electrical Contractor exam (or the Journeyman Electrician exam for journeymen)
Journeyman electricians must work under a master or state certified electrical contractor
electrical.summary: Alabama licenses electrical contractors and journeyman electricians at the state level. You first pass the Board's exam, then apply for the license. Journeymen work under a licensed electrical contractor.
electrical.quote: Electrical Contractor Examination : Any person, firm, or corporation who is engaged in the business of soliciting and installing electrical power or control systems; maintaining, altering, or repairing electrical power or control systems

evidence.quote: STEP 2: Upon Successful Completion of the Examination Determine Your Desired Status From The Criteria Below:
He or she shall work under a master or state certified electrical contractor

plumbing.name: Master Plumber / Journeyman Plumber certificate (also Master and Journeyman Gas Fitter)
plumbing.agency: Alabama Plumbers and Gas Fitters Examining Board
plumbing.covers: Anyone installing, repairing or replacing plumbing systems or gas piping. Businesses doing plumbing or gas work also register with the Board.
prerequisites: Journeyman: at least two years as a registered apprentice (or an approved apprentice program equal to two years), then pass the exam
Master: certified as a Journeyman Plumber for at least one year, then pass the Master exam
Businesses register with the Board and renew annually
plumbing.summary: Plumbers and gas fitters must be certified by the state Board. The path is apprentice, then journeyman after two years and an exam, then master after one year as a journeyman and another exam. A master plumber can register as the principal for a plumbing business.
plumbing.quote: Individuals who wish to become certified as a Journeyman Plumber must complete a minimum two years as an Apprentice, or successful completion of a board approved apprentice training program combined with time as a registered apprentice that is equal to two-years.

evidence.quote: To become eligible to take the Master Plumber Exam, an individual must be certified as a Journeyman Plumber for a minimum of one year.
This person may at any time register with the board as principal for any business, firm, or corporation.
Use the form below for new business registration, business information updates, or required annual renewals.

mechanical.name: Heating & Air Conditioning Contractor / Refrigeration Contractor certification
mechanical.agency: Alabama Board of Heating, Air Conditioning & Refrigeration Contractors
mechanical.covers: Contractors who install, service or repair heating and/or cooling equipment (not window units) or commercial refrigeration.
prerequisites: Pass the Heating & Air Conditioning (or Refrigeration) Contractors exam
Active status requires a business name and a $20,000 performance bond naming the Board
mechanical.summary: HVAC and refrigeration contractors must pass the state exam and hold Board certification. To actively do the work you need a business name and a $20,000 performance bond. Gas piping by plumbers/gas fitters is separately certified by the Plumbers and Gas Fitters Board.
mechanical.quote: Active Status: Contractors who perform HVAC or Refrigeration installation, service or repair. Requires a business name and performance bond in the amount of $20,000.

evidence.quote: Heating & Air Conditioning Contractors Examination: A heating and air conditioning contractor performs installation, service, and/or repair on a heating and/or cooling apparatus.

roofing.name: Residential Roofer License
roofing.covers: Residential roofers when the cost of the job exceeds $2,500.
prerequisites: A current (or held within the past year) city or county contractor business license
A $10,000 License/Permit Bond naming the Board as obligee
roofing.summary: Residential roofers need a Roofers license from the Home Builders Licensure Board for jobs over $2,500. You need an existing local contractor license and a $10,000 bond. Commercial roofing over $100,000 falls under the General Contractors Board.
roofing.quote: the term includes a residential roofer when the cost of the undertaking exceeds two thousand five hundred dollars ($2,500)

evidence.quote: To receive a Roofers License, request that a $10,000 License/Permit Bond naming the Board as the Obligee be submitted directly to the Board by the Surety issuing the bond.
where the cost of the undertaking including labor and materials is $100,000 or more.

pesticide.name: Commercial Pesticide Applicator certification and Structural / Horticulture Professional Services License
pesticide.agency: Alabama Department of Agriculture and Industries, Pesticide Management Section
pesticide.covers: Commercial pesticide applicators, and businesses doing household/structural pest control, termite (wood-destroying organism) control, fumigation, or ornamental and turf pest control.
prerequisites: Pass the exams for your category and apply for commercial applicator certification
The business must have a certified operator in each category of work
Business license: Professional Services (structural) or Professional Services-Horticulture (lawn/ornamental)
pesticide.insurance: Structural pest control businesses file a Certificate of Structural Insurance.
pesticide.summary: Pest control and lawn-spraying companies need certified applicators who have passed state exams, and the business needs a Professional Services license from the Department of Agriculture and Industries. Structural pest control businesses also file proof of insurance.
pesticide.quote: Once the appropriate exams have been passed, one must apply for certification through this office. If an applicator plans to start a business in the state of Alabama, a license will also be required

evidence.quote: The Structural Professional Services Licences are issued to businesses that engage in and solicit for Household, institutional & industrial Pest Control (HPC), Fumigation Pest Control (FC) and Control and/or Eradication of Wood Destroying organisms (WDC) and have a certified operator
Certificate of Structural Insurance

asbestos.name: Asbestos Removal Contractor Certification; 10-day demolition/renovation notification
asbestos.agency: Alabama Department of Environmental Management (ADEM), Air Division
asbestos.covers: Contractors removing regulated asbestos-containing material, and anyone demolishing or renovating regulated structures.
prerequisites: Asbestos removal contractors apply for ADEM certification (Form 497)
Regulated structures must be surveyed by an Alabama Accredited Asbestos Inspector before renovation or demolition
Submit a 10-day notification before disturbing regulated asbestos material or beginning demolition
asbestos.summary: Before renovating or demolishing a regulated structure, have it surveyed by an Alabama accredited asbestos inspector and file a 10-day notice with ADEM. Asbestos removal contractors must hold ADEM certification.
asbestos.quote: The regulations require a responsible party (contractor, property owner, consultant, etc.) to submit a 10-day notification to the appropriate agency prior to disturbing any regulated asbestos-containing material (RACM) or beginning demolition

evidence.quote: All regulated structures must be surveyed by an Alabama Accredited Asbestos Inspector before renovation or demolition or burning for training.
To submit a new Form 497 (Air Asbestos Removal Contractor Certification - New) for an organization not yet in AEPACS:

asbestos.note: The City of Huntsville runs its own asbestos program for projects inside the city.

lead_rrp.name: Lead-Based Paint Renovator Firm Certification and Renovator Accreditation
lead_rrp.agency: Alabama Department of Public Health (registration handled by UA SafeState)
lead_rrp.covers: Firms that perform or offer lead-based paint renovation work covered by the state lead rules. Alabama runs its own program, so EPA certification is not used here.
prerequisites: At least one employee accredited as a Renovator through an Alabama-approved course and registered with UA SafeState
Then apply for firm certification
lead_rrp.summary: Alabama is authorized to run its own lead renovation (RRP) program. Renovation firms need Alabama Department of Public Health certification, which requires at least one accredited Renovator on staff.
lead_rrp.quote: All firms which perform, or offer to perform, any of the lead-based paint renovation activities described in Alabama's lead rules must have certification from the Alabama Department of Public Health.

evidence.quote: In order to be certified as Renovator Firm, the company must have at least one individual who is accredited by and registered with UA SafeState at the University of Alabama as a Renovator.
After an individual’s accreditation number and expiration date are received, the company must then apply for firm certification through UA SafeState.

other.name: Horticulture Professional Services License (tree surgery, landscape design, setting landscape plants, ornamental & turf pest control)
other.agency: Alabama Department of Agriculture and Industries
other.summary: Businesses offering tree surgery, landscape design, landscape planting or lawn/ornamental pest control need a Horticulture Professional Services License and a certified operator who passed the category exam.
other.quote: The Horticulture Professional Services Licenses are issued to businesses that engage in and solicit for Landscape Design (LD), Tree Surgery (TS), Setting of Landscape Plants (SLP) and Ornamental & Turf Pest Control (OTPS) and have a certified operator

other.name: Master / Journeyman Gas Fitter certificate
other.agency: Alabama Plumbers and Gas Fitters Examining Board
other.summary: Installing or repairing gas piping and appliances requires state gas fitter certification (apprentice, journeyman, master).
other.quote: This is a person who engages in or works at the actual installation, repair, or replacement of gas work, who has successfully fulfilled the examination requirements of the board, has been issued a journeyman gas fitter certificate by the board
